in_marathi.name: Basudeb
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Basudeb हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Basudeb is a Sanskrit name derived from two roots: 'Basu' meaning 'Lord' and 'Deb' meaning 'Wealth'. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is believed to bestow wealth, prosperity, and fortune upon his devotees. Basudeb is often used as a name for boys born in Hindu families, as a symbol of blessings and prosperity.
